subject: [mirtCAT] How to use image, HTML or MD in options

messages.author: c7e0cfc25e45ee71
messages.subject: [mirtCAT] How to use image, HTML or MD in options
parts:
Hi, Phil!

First of all, congratulations for the packages and thanks for the help you've been providing!

I have a doubt on mirtCAT(): instead of writing the options as a vector in df$Option.1, df$Option.2, df$Option...., is it possible to easyly link to a image, or to a html or md file?

Thanks!
Alexandre Jaloto

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: [mirtCAT] How to use image, HTML or MD in options

Hi Alexandre,

See the files associated with the workshop on the public wiki:
https://github.com/philchalmers/mirtCAT/wiki

If I recall, there should be examples of how to do this (or at least
some indication of how to). HTH.
Phil
